snippet.title: This Is Not For You - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
This Is Not For You is a surreal cartography thriller about climbing an impossible lighthouse in order to turn off the light and burn it all down. After Ulysses gets visited by a ghost ship riddled with voices and letters, a curse forces him to confront a series of twisting mazes full of blood and magic. Map out a dreamlike maze and find out why he doesn't want to go home. Partially inspired by House of Leaves, the game features 2D art, 3D art and short live-action clips.

Wishlist the game! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4178650/This_Is_Not_For_You/
Follow us on socials: https://linktr.ee/interactivedreams
